UnitStatement: RuleCheckRunPanel implements the 'Run Rule Checks' GUI (PRD §22.4/§14.5, completion plan C4 GUI slice TP-C4-CHECKGUI-001) making the R3 exit criterion GUI-true.

The C4 backend (run_rule_checks command + core/rules/rule_check_runner) is engine-true; this panel surfaces per-check USER_RULE_CHECKED / USER_RULE_FAILED / RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE plus the worst-of aggregate.
Pass/fail is BLOCKED on missing inputs; the run is desktop-only and the service reports an explicit unavailable route in browser preview.
No professional, certification, sealing, approval, or code-compliance claim is made anywhere in the rule-check panel.
NO_PACK_REASON: no rule-pack document loaded; load the demo, open a saved pack, or paste a pack.
NO_SOLVE_REASON: no solved mechanics result in the session, so solver_result inputs cannot bind to result rows; run a solve first.
NO_PROJECT_REASON: saved rule packs are project-scoped; a local project must be created or opened first.
BUSY_REASON: a rule-check backend request is in progress; the user must wait for it to finish.
parsePack(text) trims input, returns null when empty, and parses JSON; it rejects non-object/array/null with 'The rule-pack document must be a JSON object.'
unitOptions(route, dimensionId, currentSymbol) builds the selectable unit options for a dimension, falling back to the current unit basis when not on the tauri_unit_catalog route.
Accepted catalog units are filtered to the binding's dimension, sorted canonical-first then by symbol, and the fallback basis is prepended if absent.
UnitBindingControl renders a catalog-backed <select> on the tauri_unit_catalog route, otherwise a free-text input, and always shows the unit-basis label.
Library reference resolution preview (Phase C3, TP-C3-LIBREFPICKER-001): a private_library_value input's library_value_ref is authored in the pack and resolved backend-side at run time.

The library preview is read-only with respect to the pack: it queries the local store to show whether the authored reference resolves and lets the user browse records/slots, never mutating or overriding the pack reference and never rendering the private value.
LIBRARY_KINDS for reference resolution are material, section, and component.
LIBRARY_RESOLUTION_LABEL maps each resolution to user text: resolves, record_missing, slot_missing, library_missing.
renderLibraryPreview renders the preview state: unavailable diagnostic, error message, unsupported-kind note, or the browsable resolution status with available libraries and records/slots.

When a library reference resolves, the private value is read at run time and never embedded in the rule pack; otherwise the check blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE until the reference points at a present record/slot.
Solver-result reference resolution preview (Phase C4, TP-C4-SOLVERREFPICKER-001): a solver_result input may carry an authored solver_result_ref (DEC-039).
The authored in-pack solver_result_ref is canonical and supersedes the run-panel selector; the preview is read-only and never invents a fallback binding.
SOLVER_RESULT_RESOLUTION_LABEL maps each resolution to user text: resolves, result_missing, no_result_rows.
renderSolverPreview shows whether the authored result_id resolves in the current solved envelope and lists up to 12 available result rows for discovery.
RuleCheckRunPanel takes model, result, optional onAggregateChange, and optional onR3JourneyEvent props.

onAggregateChange lifts the worst-of rule-check aggregate to the app to wire into the app-held analysis-run envelope (TP-C4-APPAGG-001), called with the aggregate on success or null when there is no current run outcome.
projectId is derived from model.project.id; the parsed pack and the derived RuleCheckBindingPlan are memoized over the pack text.
hasRuntimeUnitBindings is true when the plan has value inputs or value slots, gating whether the unit catalog must be loaded.
An effect loads the DEC-018 unit catalog when runtime unit bindings exist, setting an unavailable_browser_preview route with a diagnostic on failure, and cancels on unmount.
resetForNewPack(text) clears solver selections, value bindings, run result, and library/solver previews, and invalidates the app-held aggregate via onAggregateChange(null).

handlePreviewLibrary previews whether an input's authored library_value_ref resolves in the local store and captures available libraries/records/slots; read-only, never mutating the pack or run binding.
A library_kind not in material/section/component yields a note that the reference cannot resolve at run time.
handlePreviewLibrary lists local libraries, finds the matching kind+library_id, opens it, indexes records/slots, and classifies the reference; browser-preview routes surface their diagnostic.
bindingUnit(refId, fallback) returns the user-bound unit for a ref or the fallback unit.
handlePreviewSolver classifies the input's solver_result_ref result_id against the current solved result rows.

handleLoadDemo loads the bundled invented demonstration rule pack, resets state, fires the rule_check_pack_loaded journey event, and labels it an invented non-engineering example, not an engineering design basis.
handleRefreshList lists saved rule packs for the current project (or across all local projects), handling the unavailable_browser_preview route.
handleOpen loads a saved rule pack envelope for run, resets state, and fires the rule_check_pack_loaded journey event.
buildSolverBindings maps solver inputs without an authored solver_result_ref to {input_id, result_id} selectors, dropping empty selections.
buildSuppliedBindings collects supplied value bindings from value inputs and value slots, parsing the value to a finite number and attaching unit and dimension.
handleRun calls runRuleChecks with the pack document, model, solved envelope, solver-result bindings, supplied value bindings, and projectId; it blocks when no valid pack/plan exists.
On a successful run, handleRun sets the run result, lifts the worst-of aggregate via onAggregateChange (TP-C4-APPAGG-001), and reports check count, aggregate, and grammar version.
handleRun fires the rule_check_run_requested journey event before invoking the backend.
The Run button is disabled when the pack does not parse or a request is in flight; the disabled reason is NO_PACK_REASON or BUSY_REASON.
Unbound or missing inputs block the check at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE; pass/fail is never reported on missing inputs.
On the tauri_unit_catalog route the DEC-018 unit catalog backs run-check value bindings; browser preview keeps run-check unit refs as stored manual text with no fallback catalog synthesized.
An authored solver_result_ref result_id resolves from the current solved result envelope at run time, supersedes the run-panel selector, and is removed in the editor to return to manual binding.
A private_library_value input resolves from library_kind:library_id → record → slot at run time on desktop; the value stays in the library and is never embedded in the rule pack.

Boundary note: rule checks run locally over user-supplied data only; the software emits user-defined check statuses and never a code-compliance, certification, sealing, approval, authentication, or professional acceptance claim. Human review remains required.
aggregateLabel maps USER_RULE_CHECKED to '(pass)', USER_RULE_FAILED to '(fail)', and RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE to '(blocked on missing inputs)'.

CheckDefinitionsEditor (Phase C2 slice 5, TP-C2-CHECKDEF-001) implements PRD §14.5's requirement to let a user author the rule pack's acceptability checks.

check_definitions — binding declared required_inputs/value_slots and a formula into a check — was the last document-structure member previously hand-edited as raw JSON; this component replaces that with structured form controls.
Boundary: purely structured form controls with no writable expression text syntax (D-02b AWAITING_RULING); a check binds references and selects closed-vocabulary tokens, never expression text.

The software authors the check's shape only; it never decides pass/fail acceptance (the engine independently blocks incomplete checks — C4) and never fills in a code or standards value. Editing is lossless.
Editable enum vocabularies are copied verbatim from rule_pack.schema.yaml so controls emit only schema-valid tokens, and exported so a schema-conformance test can assert set equality.
ACCEPTABILITY_BASES = user_supplied_rule_pack, owner_design_basis, private_project_basis, invented_non_engineering_example, TBD.
ACCEPTABILITY_RELATIONS is the four ordering relations only (equality acceptance is a deliberate schema non-goal), mapping to the frozen grammar's comparison operators (DEC-022).
The runner defaults an absent acceptability relation to less_than_or_equal, so the editor authors it explicitly and never relies on a silent default.
ANALYSIS_STATUSES = MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
DIAGNOSTIC_CODES enumerates the ten rule diagnostic codes including RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, RULE_INPUT_MISSING, RULE_UNIT_MISMATCH, and RULE_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_NOTICE.
DIAGNOSTIC_POLICY_FIELDS are the eight DiagnosticPolicy fields in schema order, each mapping a rule-check condition to its emitted diagnostic code.
readCheckIds returns the declared check_id values in document order, empty when none or malformed.
readFormulaDeclarationIds returns the declared formula_id values in document order, empty when none or malformed.
defaultDiagnosticPolicy returns a schema-valid DiagnosticPolicy with all eight condition→code bindings, byte-identical to the draft template's policy.

defaultCheckDefinition returns a schema-valid CheckDefinition with a fresh unique id, single-ref arrays bound to the first declared ids (or the 'TBD' placeholder), user-rule basis/statuses, default policy, and placeholder provenance; no numeric, code, or standards content is invented.
setCheckDefinitions returns a new document with the check_definitions array replaced.

RefSelect surfaces a ref pointing at an undeclared id as an '(unresolved)' option rather than silently snapping it to the first declared id; backend validation independently flags dangling references.

ResultStatusToggles renders one checkbox per known AnalysisStatus plus any stored out-of-vocabulary token kept visible/removable as '(current)', with the minItems:1 floor blocking unchecking the last selected status.
CheckDefinitionsEditor writes edits into a structurally-copied document handed to onChange; the parent owns serialization and persistence.
updateCheck patches one check by index while untouched checks round-trip verbatim.
addCheck appends a defaultCheckDefinition bound to the declared ids.
removeCheck filters out the check at the given index.
updateRef edits a reference id while preserving sibling members the ref already carried via structural spread.
addRef appends a new reference defaulting to the first declared option id or 'TBD'.
removeRef removes a reference unless only one remains.
updateFormulaRef sets the formula_ref ref_id while preserving its existing members.
updateDiagnosticPolicy sets one diagnostic-policy field's code while preserving the rest.
toggleResultStatus appends a status when toggled on and removes it when toggled off, refusing to drop below the minItems:1 schema floor.
Removing a check is blocked when only one remains: a rule pack needs at least one check definition.

Test: uniqueDeclarationId generates a unique id, skipping ids already present and advancing past collisions on the length-derived candidate.

Test/note: LibraryValueRef.library_kind has no 'TBD' member in the schema, so LIBRARY_KINDS is exactly material, section, component.

Test: defaultSolverResultRef builds a reference with only result_id set to the 'TBD' placeholder; an unfilled reference matches no result row and the input blocks.
Test: the editor lists declared required inputs and value slots with their ids.
Test: adding a required input creates a fresh unique id with a schema-valid default (user_supplied_rule_value, TBD dimension).

Test: editing a required input's identity, source kind, dimension, unit, required-for, and completeness updates the document, and the nested quantity_intent edit preserves the const-true relaxation flags.
Test: the DEC-018 catalog supplies required-input unit refs filtered to the dimension (Pa and MPa for stress) without offering incompatible dimensions (no m, no lbf).
Test: an out-of-catalog stored unit stays visible as 'catalog mismatch' current instead of being snapped, until the user selects a catalog unit.
Test: removing the last required input is blocked (minItems 1), and add-then-remove is lossless.
Test: a value slot's kind, value status, and dimension can be added and edited, with the quantity_intent edit preserving relaxation flags.
Test: the DEC-018 catalog supplies value-slot unit refs.
Test: removing the last value slot is blocked.
Test: editing one declaration preserves sibling declarations verbatim, including the full provenance block.
Test: an out-of-vocabulary stored source_kind is surfaced as a '(current)' option, not a silent snap.
Test: the shared DimensionSelect surfaces an out-of-vocabulary stored dimension as '(current)' without snapping it to TBD.
Test: every control is disabled while a backend request is in flight.
